item: Row 270: parallel dump test proves concurrency at a barrier, never by a timed poll
summary: The capacity test failed on a loaded macOS runner: the fake body gave up waiting after 5 s and completed the download before the poll looked. Now start()'s synchronous claim is read at once, the fake fetch waits at a threading.Barrier until all workers are inside it together, and the body never completes on a timeout. dumps.py unchanged; a capacity-1 manager fails the test in under a second.
